# UGC Markets

> UGC Markets is the dedicated home of influUGC's service-providers marketplace. influUGC is a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. On the marketplace, brands post content briefs and hire vetted service providers — videographers, photographers, editors, designers and studios — while providers sell their craft from a public profile; every order runs through a deal chat with payment protected by escrow on the platform wallet. The marketplace opens in phases across Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf, and a waitlist is open.

## How it works

- For Brands: post one brief, receive offers from matching providers, check public profiles and portfolios (identity-verified providers carry a badge), fund the platform wallet, run the order in a deal chat, and release payment only on approving the delivery.
- For Providers: a public profile with services, portfolio and self-set rates; open briefs by category to answer with offers; the client funds escrow before work starts and approval releases the payment; providers and creators can follow each other inside the influUGC network.
- Service categories: videography, photography, editing & post-production, design & motion, sound & voice, studios & locations, casting.

## Guides (published on the homepage)

- [How UGC marketplaces work](https://ugc.markets/#guide-marketplaces): the full deal flow — the brand posts one brief, matching providers answer with offers, the client funds the platform wallet (escrow), the order runs in a deal chat, and the client's approval of the delivery is what releases the payment to the provider.
- [Escrow payments for creative work, explained](https://ugc.markets/#guide-escrow): how holding the client's money with the platform protects both sides — the brand never pays for work it did not receive, the provider never starts unfunded work, revisions happen in the deal chat against the original brief, and approval, not mere delivery, is the release trigger.
- [How to write a creator brief that gets good offers](https://ugc.markets/#guide-brief): what providers need in a brief to answer with serious, honest offers — the exact deliverable, format and specs, a real deadline, style references, usage stated upfront, and an honest budget range — plus the mistakes that get a brief ignored.
- Arabic versions of all three guides: https://ugc.markets/ar.html#guides
